name: UGC still · product in hand
description: A phone-camera still of the product held in one hand against an everyday background. Use it for a thumbnail, a first frame, or a plain social post that does not look like a studio shot.
prompt: Phone-camera photograph: the product in image 1, unchanged in shape, colour and label, held in one hand at chest height against a {{ background }}. Daylight from a window, slight handheld tilt, true skin texture on the hand, shallow depth of field, the label sharp and readable. {{#if extra}}{{ extra }}.{{/if}} No text, no watermark, no studio backdrop.
negative_prompt: studio lighting, seamless backdrop, warped label, extra hands, text, watermark
author: kilnry
